Equivalent stiffness & eigenfrequency calculator

Combine up to six springs in series or parallel and compute the eigenfrequency of a mass on the result.

How it works

Springs in series share the same force, so their compliances (1/C) add. Springs in parallel share the same displacement, so their stiffnesses add.

Key points

  • In series the weakest element dominates. A stiff frame cannot compensate for a compliant joint.
  • Eigenfrequency f₀ = (1/2π)·√(C/m).
  • Rule of thumb: f₀ ≈ 15.8/√(δ[mm]) Hz, where δ is the static sag under gravity.

Assumptions

  • Linear springs
  • Lumped (rigid) mass
